comment: The actuator line's polar per library prop (L72k B1, docs/design/physics/plans/2026-11-17-b1-polar-fits.md): the estimated polar's two free parameters, fitted through the line WITH THE TIP CORRECTION ON so it reproduces the prop's UIUC static C_T and C_Q. Each fit holds only for the kernel width and resolution it was made at and with the tip correction on. A prop not listed here (triblade_6inch_scaled) has no fit and stays ESTIMATED. polar_fits.py turns this into tests/library_polar_fits.gen.hpp; the part files take their values from that header.

fits.fit: 12 mm kernel (2.93 cells), R/dx 31, 5000 rpm, D 10 in; line C_T 0.09619 vs UIUC 0.09636, C_Q 0.005886 vs 0.005870
12 mm kernel (2.94 cells), R/dx 28, 5008 rpm, D 9 in; line C_T 0.09816 vs UIUC 0.09818, C_Q 0.006146 vs 0.006129

12 mm kernel (2.83 cells), R/dx 15, 6057 rpm, D 5 in, 3 blades; line C_T 0.18089 vs UIUC 0.18147, C_Q 0.019029 vs 0.018924; a LARGE drag scale, a calibration to the static point and not a measured section
6 mm kernel (2.55 cells), R/dx 10, 16582 rpm, D 47 mm; line C_T 0.15653 vs UIUC 0.15586, C_Q 0.016599 vs 0.016764; a static-only prop, one point, nothing held out
